question: Find the simple interest on ₹36,000 at an annual rate of 22% over an 8 month period.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹36,000

Annual Rate of Interest (R) = 22%

Time (T) = 8 months = 8/12 years = 2/3 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T)/(100)
